top_signals.title: Colleges Rejecting Fossil Fuel Divestment Enjoy a Rich Payoff
top_signals.summary: For years, campus and environmental activists concerned about climate change have pressured colleges to divest from fossil fuel companies. But those that hung tight are now glad they did. Bloomberg’s Janet Lorin explains. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Anthropic loses $1 trillion crown as it sinks below IPO price
top_signals.summary: Anthropic lost its $1 trillion market capitalisation on Tuesday after the firm’s shares dropped below their initial public offering price. The Claude maker’s valuation surged to $2 trillion on its public market last week, but its valuation has since sunk to $998.2bn, as investors continue to rotate out of tech stocks following Monday’s blistering rally.
